question: does the due-west cross line 10010 give each gen1 flight line its OWN across-track coefficient, and does the resulting network close?

inputs.role: raw 2008 gen1 LAZ tile carrying the cross line 10010 and the N-S lines 135-138, vendor classification
our CSF ground (class 2) for that tile, from analysis/slope_bias/csf_tiled.py at classify_ground_csf defaults

params.name: block_m
params.why: the cluster block size of swath_across_track_test.py

params.name: min_cell_line
params.why: 1 is the definitional floor -- a median needs one value, so it imposes NO cut. It is swath_across_track_test.py's own default; Sec 6 re-runs the cross-line fits at 3 and 5 and reports how far every coefficient moves.

params.name: reference surface for the cross tile
params.value: 'pooled gen1 ground of the same tile'
params.why: gen2 does not cover this tile, so the pipeline's gen2 Zreg cannot be formed. A common per-cell reference cancels in a between-line difference; Sec 2 measures the substitution on elbaext's N-S pairs instead of asserting it. It excludes nothing: every cell with ground in it keeps its ground.

columns.psid: point_source_id, i.e. the flight line, dimensionless integer
columns.n_raw: returns of that line in the raw vendor tile, all classes
columns.frac2: fraction of them the VENDOR classified 2 (bare earth)
columns.n_csf: returns of that line our CSF classified as ground (class 2)
columns.n_csf_last: of those, last returns (rn == nr) -- the pipeline's ground selection
columns.csf_rate: n_csf / n_raw: what fraction of the line's returns CSF calls ground
columns.dens: n_csf_last per square metre over the cells that line covers
columns.cells: 5 m cells the pair shares, with >= min_cell_line ground returns each
columns.area_ha: area of those shared cells, hectares
columns.pair: unordered flight-line pair A-B (point_source_id), A < B
columns.kind: N-S/N-S = both lines fly the boustrophedon; CROSS = one is line 10010
columns.tile: derived-product directory or LAS the estimate comes from
columns.estimator: which per-(cell,line) ground quantity was differenced
columns.corr_AB: Pearson correlation of the two lines' per-cell tan(scan angle)
columns.sd_sum: standard deviation of tanA+tanB over the shared cells
columns.sd_dif: standard deviation of tanA-tanB over the shared cells
columns.se_ratio: SE(q)/SE(p) from the design matrix alone: how many times worse the ANTISYMMETRIC coefficient is determined than the symmetric one. 1 = the pair separates the two lines
columns.blocks: independent spatial blocks spanned by the shared cells
columns.k_mm: fitted intercept at tanA = tanB = 0, mm; + = line A reads above line B
columns.k_se: cluster-robust standard error of k_mm, mm
columns.c_pair: two-parameter coefficient on tanA-tanB = (c_A+c_B)/2, mm per unit tangent -- the SAME model and estimator as SWATH_ACROSS_TRACK_TEST Sec 2
columns.c_pair_se: cluster-robust standard error of c_pair, mm per unit tangent
columns.p: three-parameter coefficient on tanA-tanB, mm per unit tangent
columns.p_se: cluster-robust standard error of p, mm per unit tangent
columns.q: coefficient on tanA+tanB = (c_A-c_B)/2, the combination a N-S overlap CANNOT see, mm per unit tangent
columns.q_se: cluster-robust standard error of q, mm per unit tangent
columns.c_A: p+q: the lower-numbered line's OWN across-track coefficient, mm/unit tangent
columns.c_A_se: cluster-robust standard error of c_A, mm per unit tangent
columns.c_B: p-q: the higher-numbered line's OWN across-track coefficient, mm/unit tangent
columns.c_B_se: cluster-robust standard error of c_B, mm per unit tangent
columns.r2: coefficient of determination of that fit
columns.t: coefficient divided by its cluster-robust standard error
columns.line: flight line (point_source_id) whose own coefficient is being reported
columns.c_own: that line's own across-track coefficient, mm per unit tangent
columns.c_own_se: its standard error, mm per unit tangent
columns.source: how that line's coefficient was obtained: measured on a cross pair, or propagated along the N-S chain from a measured one
columns.predicted: the pair sum (c_A+c_B)/2 implied by the individually measured coefficients, mm per unit tangent
columns.observed: the pair sum measured directly on that N-S overlap, mm per unit tangent
columns.resid: predicted - observed, mm per unit tangent: the redundancy residual
columns.resid_sig: resid divided by the quadrature sum of the two standard errors
columns.r_tA_E: correlation of line A's per-cell tan(scan) with cell EASTING
columns.r_tA_N: correlation of line A's per-cell tan(scan) with cell NORTHING
columns.r_tB_E: correlation of line B's per-cell tan(scan) with cell EASTING
columns.r_tB_N: correlation of line B's per-cell tan(scan) with cell NORTHING
columns.kind_check: whether the row is a genuine redundancy check, i.e. whether both lines' coefficients were measured on the cross line rather than propagated from this very pair sum
columns.variant: which sensitivity run produced the row
columns.d_c136: change in c_136 from the headline run, mm per unit tangent
columns.d_c137: change in c_137 from the headline run, mm per unit tangent
columns.d_c138: change in c_138 from the headline run, mm per unit tangent
columns.d_c10010: change in the mean c_10010 from the headline run, mm per unit tangent

headline: per-line across-track coefficients from the cross line, and the network
unasked: reference surface for the cross tile
